title: Stolk et al. 2018 FieldTrip iEEG protocol dataset (SubjectUCI29): authors' preprocessed ECoG+SEEG epochs
description: Preprocessed intracranial EEG (ECoG and SEEG) from one epilepsy patient (SubjectUCI29) performing an auditory target-detection task, released with the FieldTrip human intracranial analysis protocol of Stolk et al. (2018). The dataset contains 26 tone-locked epochs of 152 channels sampled at 5000 Hz, demeaned, low-pass filtered at 200 Hz and band-stop filtered at line-noise harmonics. Electrode positions in subject ACPC and MNI space are included. Raw recordings were not shared by the authors, so this is a derivative BIDS packaging.
methods_description: Recordings were acquired with a Nihon Kohden JE-120A amplifier at 5 kHz with an analog high-pass above 0.01 Hz, from 96 ECoG contacts (parietal and temporal grids) and 56 SEEG depth contacts. The patient pressed a button on hearing a target tone. Trials were cut from -0.4 to 0.9 s around tone onset, demeaned, low-pass filtered at 200 Hz and band-stop filtered at 59-61, 119-121 and 179-181 Hz using FieldTrip ft_preprocessing.
